title: Why Tommy Vercetti went to prison before GTA Vice City
subject: tommy
description:
Would you have trusted Sonny Forelli again? 👇

How one night in Harwood cost Tommy Vercetti fifteen years and sent him to Vice City. Spoilers for GTA Vice City.

scenes.text: Tommy Vercetti spent fifteen years in prison for one night in Harwood.
In 1971, Sonny Forelli sent him to kill a man in Liberty City. It was an ambush, and Tommy killed eleven men.
After that, Liberty City only knew him as the Harwood Butcher.
He was released in 1986, and Sonny shipped him south to Vice City to oversee a cocaine deal.
Gunmen hit the deal. Victor Vance was killed, and Tommy lost both the money and the drugs.
Sonny wanted his money back. Tommy decided to take the whole city instead.
